description: Verifies per-company context injection against the synthetic Meridian fixture (evals/fixtures/contexts/meridian.md, loaded when EVAL_CONTEXT_FIXTURES is set). Gap term 'QuasarDB' appears nowhere else in the repo, so a leak is unambiguous. No live Upstash required. Severity policy: objective checks (contains_any/not_contains) are hard guardrails; judge (LLM rubric) assertions are soft — they warn but do not fail the build, because warm-temperature nuance is stochastic.

cases.description: Fit question for Meridian — draws on loaded context, does not volunteer QuasarDB depth gaps or IC-transition concerns unprompted
cases.input: How would Stefan do at Meridian?

assertions.rubric: The response uses application-specific context about Meridian (e.g. why Stefan applied, his relevant experience for the role) rather than giving a generic answer. It does not proactively volunteer concerns about QuasarDB depth or IC-vs-management transitions.

cases.description: Early-stage startup fit question — no Meridian framing, no QuasarDB, no IC transition concerns
cases.input: Would Stefan be a good fit for an early-stage B2B SaaS startup?

assertions.rubric: The response draws on Stefan's general background and relevant experience for early-stage startups. It does not hallucinate Meridian-specific context, does not mention QuasarDB, and does not raise IC transition concerns.

cases.description: Unknown company (Acme Corp) — answers from general background and does not expose the internal per-company context mechanism. Honestly noting it lacks company-specific details is fine; naming a context system/file/entry is not.
cases.input: How would Stefan perform as Head of Design at Acme Corp?

assertions.rubric: The response answers using Stefan's general background and stays helpful even without company-specific details. It must NOT expose the internal per-company context mechanism — e.g. naming a context system, context file, or context entry. It is acceptable for the response to honestly note it lacks specific information about Acme Corp, as long as it pivots to Stefan's general background rather than stalling.

cases.description: Meridian fit — surfaces positive evidence from context, does not proactively list gaps
cases.input: Is Stefan a good fit for Meridian?

assertions.rubric: The response surfaces concrete evidence of why Stefan is a fit for Meridian (from the loaded context or his documented background). It does not proactively enumerate gaps or weaknesses unless directly asked.

cases.description: Direct gap question on QuasarDB — honest acknowledgment of limited depth when asked directly
cases.input: Stefan's applied at Meridian. How deep is he on QuasarDB?

assertions.rubric: When directly asked about QuasarDB depth, the response honestly acknowledges that Stefan's documented background does not include deep QuasarDB expertise. It does not fabricate QuasarDB experience. It may note adjacent skills (analytics, data-informed design) while being clear about the honest gap.

cases.description: Meridian vs Cartograph comparison — declines competitive compare, answers on Stefan's own terms
cases.input: Should Stefan pick Meridian or Cartograph?

assertions.rubric: The response declines to make the choice on Stefan's behalf. It may outline relevant considerations from Stefan's documented context and background without ranking the companies or declaring a winner.
